senses.gloss: (b. h.; kneading-trough, dough of one trough, batch.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 67a">Men. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>עֲרִיסַת גוי</he>; <he>ע׳ הקדש</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עִיסַת</he>).—Pl. <cite ref="P01370"><he>עֲרִיסוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 135b:11">Ḥull. 135ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 15:20">Num. XV, 20</cite>) <he>כדי עֲרִיסוֹתֵיכֶם</he> of the size of your batches (in the desert); Men. l. c. Ms. M. (ed. <he>עִיסוֹת׳</he>; <cite ref="Eruvin 83b:1">Erub. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>עיס׳</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:1">Kel. XVI, 1</cite> <he>המטה והע׳</he> a couch or a cradle; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1:8">Y. Ber. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>המיטה הערסה</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 26:5">Kel. XXVI, 5</cite> <he>עור הע׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 8</cite> <he>ועור האריסה</he> ed. Zuck. (omitted in oth. ed.), v. <cite ref="P00345"><he>עוֹר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 7:12">Ib. VII, 12</cite> <he>עֲרִיסָא של זכוכית</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <cite ref="P01369"><he>עריסה</he></cite>) a glass cradle(?).
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:1">Nidd. IV, 1</cite> <he>מעֲרִיסָתָן</he> from their cradle (earliest childhood).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:10">Gen. R. s. 53</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00234"><he>נִדְנֵד</he></cite>. Y. Macc. II, beg. 31ᶜ <he>ישב לו ע״ג ע׳ ביום ודרך התינוק ע״ג ע׳ ביום וכ׳</he> if he sat down on a cradle in day time (and caused a child’s death): where it is customary to place a child in the cradle in day time, he does not go into exile (to the city of refuge, because his act is one of criminal neglect); a. fr.
